about: Test files that take over about 5 seconds. `npm run test:slow` runs them; `npm test`, `npm run check` and the per-part test:* scripts run every other file. Nothing here is skipped for good: each file keeps its measured time so it can move back once it is faster. Seconds on a busy machine at the load given: alone is the file run by itself, full_run its duration inside `npx vitest run`.

files.covers: storage across processes: 20 publishes of one name from 20 processes, and 30 rounds of 10 processes opening one fresh catalog
